source.title: WRC Leader Announcement (December 2022)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Antonio Kam is the new Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Antonio was already working as a member of the WRC.

Antonio was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Iván Brigidano Pérez for the work he has done for the WRC, and wish Antonio Kam best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Antonio was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HTRzeD4vYqn3-Pi4M7rneYelId-O2Uyp?usp=share_link) if you are interested in viewing them. 

Other candidates who applied:

* Samuel Baird

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人任命公告（2022 年 12 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Antonio Kam 已成为 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）的新任负责人。Antonio 此前已是 WRC 成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Antonio，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Iván Brigidano Pérez 为 WRC 所做的工作，也祝 Antonio Kam 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

本次共有两位申请人，包括 Antonio。有兴趣的成员可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HTRzeD4vYqn3-Pi4M7rneYelId-O2Uyp?usp=share_link)查看两人的申请材料。

另一位申请人为：

* Samuel Baird
